verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no ZCode sandbox, test environment, or dry-run mode that keeps agent actions away from production data. The only isolation mentioned is user-side: community members suggest wrapping ZCode in sandbox-exec/agent-safehouse or running it under a separate account, and a workaround like that earns no credit. The ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR setting only relocates the app's own data and is an adjacent control, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
